messages:
Priya M: Heads-up: I'm drafting an implementation options doc for private-deploy upgrades. Three modes on the table: ip-stable rolling (minimal network change), dual-operator cutover (parallel, swap routes), and airgap-patch (offline bundle). Want to minimize firewall/peering changes for customers. Can we list constraints and acceptance gates?

Omar K: Agree on the three. Quick constraint: ip-stable rolling requires kernel/CNI invariants; we need a preflight to detect any kernel module mis-matches. If detected, recommend dual-operator.

Devon S: Dual-operator is safer for enterprise but customers hate extra infra cost. Suggest automating a warm-handoff: snapshot state, warm caches, switch traffic via a short DNS TTL trick or iptables redirect.

Rhea P: Field note: a few regulated customers demand "no inbound port changes" and signed artifacts for airgap. For airgap mode add a checksum/signature verification step and a signed manifest.

NetOps J: From ops side: ip-stable rolling needs a node-level helper that preserves host routes and interface names. That helper will need privileged daemonset perms. We'll document minimal SA/RBAC.

Ops-Bot: Canary report: private-upgrade-canary-20240401 — CNI probe failed on kernel 5.15 variant. See https://ci.internal/canary/20240401/logs

Marco L: UX suggestion: installer flags: --mode=(ip-stable|cutover|airgap), --preflight, --max-downtime=minutes. Preflight should output a short table: PASS/WARN/FAIL for cni, kernel, kms, dns, ntp drift.

Priya M: Good. Proposed acceptance gates for GA: 1) Preflight detects top 6 issues and provides remediation hints; 2) Installer supports ip-stable and cutover modes; 3) Airgap bundle signed and testable offline; 4) Runbook + rollback tested with one pilot customer; 5) RBAC/daemonset perms documented.

Omar K: Technical checklist additions: KV migration hook (snapshot & restore), ip-preserve shim (best-effort, with metrics exposing preserved vs reallocated IPs), and a smoke-test to validate qps & error-rate after cutover.

Devon S: Rollback semantics: cutover must allow immediate revert without losing in-flight requests — we need idempotent replay for queued ops. I'll prototype a revert flag that flips traffic back to old operator and replays missing ops from the snapshot.

Rhea P: Pilot selection: pick one customer on Calico + one on Cilium. Need staging window and support rota. I'll volunteer to run the field by May.

NetOps J: I'll draft the minimal RBAC + host capability list (NET_ADMIN, CAP_SYS_ADMIN? confirm). Also will prototype a small daemonset that maintains host iptables rules across upgrades.

Marco L: CLI example for docs:
```
rw-installer upgrade --mode=cutover --preflight --max-downtime=10
```
Preflight returns actionable list and an estimated maintenance window.

Priya M: Action items: Marco 10: spec CLI + preflight output examples. Omar 19: design ip-preserve shim and metric set. Devon 16: revert/proof-of-concept. NetOps J 12: RBAC & daemonset prototype. Rhea 18: pick pilots. I'll assemble acceptance checklist and add to the roadmap ticket.

Omar K: One more: add a toggle to keep kube-proxy mode unchanged where possible; switching proxy modes is a big footgun for customers.

Priya M: Noted. If no objections I'll convert this thread into the roadmap epic and open subtasks. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
